runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-145-## Docker Socket (Sandbox Execution)
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-146-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:147:Moltis runs LLM-generated shell commands inside isolated containers for
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-148-security. When Moltis itself runs in a container, it needs access to the host's
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-149-container runtime to create these sandbox containers.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-150-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:151:```bash
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-152-# Recommended for full container isolation
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-153--v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-172-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-173-```toml
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:174:[tools.exec.sandbox]
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-175-host_data_dir = "/absolute/host/path/to/data"
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-176-```
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-177-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-178-For a bind mount like `-v ./data:/home/moltis/.moltis`, use the resolved host
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:179:path to `./data`. This setting is also used by sandboxed browser containers for
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:180:their persistent Chrome profile directory. If browser startup logs show
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:181:`/data/browser-profile/SingletonLock: Permission denied`, Moltis probably fell
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-182-back to the in-container path (`/home/moltis/.moltis/...`) instead of the real
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-183-host path. Set `host_data_dir` to the host-visible data directory and restart
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:184:Moltis so new sandbox and browser containers pick up the corrected mount
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-185-source.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-186-
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-200-services:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-201-  moltis:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:202:    image: ghcr.io/moltis-org/moltis:latest
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-203-    container_name: moltis
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-204-    restart: unless-stopped
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-213-```
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-214-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:215:For unattended recovery after host reboots or in-place `/update`, store the
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:216:vault recovery key as a Docker secret and point Moltis at the mounted file:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-217-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-218-```yaml
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-219-services:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-220-  moltis:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:221:    image: ghcr.io/moltis-org/moltis:latest
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-222-    environment:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:223:      MOLTIS_VAULT_AUTO_UNSEAL_KEY_FILE: /run/secrets/moltis_vault_recovery_key
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-224-    secrets:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:225:      - moltis_vault_recovery_key
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-226-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-227-secrets:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:228:  moltis_vault_recovery_key:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:229:    file: ./moltis-vault-recovery-key
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-230-```
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-231-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-232-This lets encrypted environment variables and channel credentials load during
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:233:startup. Treat the secret file as sensitive as the vault recovery key itself.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-234-If you create the secret file before the vault is initialized, Docker will
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-235-accept the mount but Moltis cannot auto-unseal from an empty file. After you
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:236:initialize the vault in **Settings > Encryption**, copy the one-time recovery
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-237-key into this file before relying on unattended auto-unseal.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-238-
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-251-  are redirected to `:13131`, check that TLS is disabled in Moltis.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-252-- Keep `/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock` mounted if you want sandbox
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:253:  isolation for exec tools.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-254-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-255-Start with:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-256-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:257:```bash
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-258-docker compose up -d
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-259-docker compose logs -f moltis  # watch for startup messages
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-260-```
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-261-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:262:## Browser Sandbox in Docker
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-263-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:264:When Moltis runs inside Docker and launches a sandboxed browser, the browser
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-265-container is a sibling container on the host. By default, Moltis connects to
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:266:`127.0.0.1` which only reaches its own loopback, not the browser.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-267-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:268:The sibling browser also needs a host-visible mount for its Chrome profile. If
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-269-your Moltis data directory is bind-mounted or stored somewhere that is not
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-270-visible on the host as `/home/moltis/.moltis`, configure
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:271:`[tools.exec.sandbox].host_data_dir` as described in
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-272-[Docker Socket Sandbox Execution](#docker-socket-sandbox-execution). Without
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-273-that override, Chrome may fail with `SingletonLock: Permission denied` when the
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:274:browser container tries to write `/data/browser-profile`.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-275-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:276:Add `container_host` to your `moltis.toml` so Moltis can reach the browser
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-277-container through the host's port mapping:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-278-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-279-```toml
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:280:[tools.browser]
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-281-container_host = "host.docker.internal"
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-282-```
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-285-resolves to the host:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-286-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:287:```bash
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-288-docker run -d \
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-289-  --name moltis \
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-295-  -v moltis-data:/home/moltis/.moltis \
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-296-  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:297:  ghcr.io/moltis-org/moltis:latest
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-298-```
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-299-

runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-306-socket instead of the Docker socket:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-307-

runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-319-

runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-366-### API Keys and the `[env]` Section
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-367-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:368:Features like web search (Brave), embeddings, and LLM provider API calls read
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-369-keys from process environment variables (`std::env::var`). In Docker, there are
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-370-three ways to provide these:
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-378-services:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-379-  moltis:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:380:    image: ghcr.io/moltis-org/moltis:latest
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-381-    environment:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-382-      MOLTIS_TOKEN: "change-me"
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-392-**Option 2: Provider-specific `docker -e` flags** (takes precedence for that provider)
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-393-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md:394:```bash
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-395-docker run -d \
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/docker.md-396-  --name moltis \

runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:170:### Tools in Shared Channels
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-171-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:172:By default, Slack channels and DMs from non-operators receive no tools. To let
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:173:those turns use tools, lift both parts of the untrusted-turn ceiling and use a
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:174:tool policy to restrict what is available:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-175-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-176-```toml

runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:179:untrusted_tools = "policy"
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-180-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:181:[channels.slack.my-bot.tools.groups.channel]
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-182-allow = ["linear_*"]
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-183-

runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-186-```
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-187-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-188-`untrusted_audience = "trusted"` makes MCP, WASM, and other trusted-audience
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:189:tools eligible. `untrusted_tools = "policy"` removes the blanket name denial.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:190:Both settings are required for MCP tools, and without a restrictive policy the
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:191:turn can reach every tool allowed by the remaining policy layers.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-192-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-193-The ceiling applies to every turn outside an operator direct chat, so restrict
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-194-both `channel` and `direct` when non-operator DMs are enabled. For accounts
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-195-created in the web UI, Advanced Config can set the two ceiling fields, but
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:196:database-backed `tools.groups` policies are not currently part of runtime

runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-198-lifting the ceiling on a UI-managed account.

runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:356:(`in_progress`, `complete`, or `error`); Moltis does not send tool arguments,

--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-376-- 👀 (`eyes`) is added as soon as the message starts processing.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-377-- While the agent runs, the reaction swaps to a **phase** emoji reflecting the
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:378:  current tool — 🌐 web, 💻 shell, ✏️ file edits, 🛠️ other tools — and shows ⏳ if
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-379-  a step runs long. Rapid changes are debounced so the reaction doesn't flicker.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-380-- ✅ (`white_check_mark`) replaces it when the reply is delivered.
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-399-With `reaction_triggers = true`, when a user adds an emoji reaction to a message,
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-400-Moltis routes it into the agent as a synthetic message (threaded under the
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md:401:reacted message so the agent sees the original content as context). This enables
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/slack.md-402-flows like "react ✅ to approve" or "react 👍 to continue".

--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-3-The system prompt sent to the LLM is assembled dynamically from multiple
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-4-components. Each piece is optional and loaded only when relevant, keeping the
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:5:prompt compact while adapting to the current session context.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-6-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-7-## Assembly Order
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-10-`build_system_prompt_full()`. Components are appended in this order:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-11-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:12:1. **Base introduction** — one-liner announcing tool access (or not)
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-13-2. **Agent identity** — name, emoji, creature, vibe from `IDENTITY.md`
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-14-3. **Soul** — personality directives from `SOUL.md` (or built-in default)
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-15-4. **User profile** — user's name from `USER.md`
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:16:5. **Project context** — `CLAUDE.md` / `CLAUDE.local.md` / `AGENTS.md` / `.cursorrules` / `.claude/rules/*.md` / `.cursor/rules/*.{md,mdc}`
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-17-   walked up the directory tree
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:18:6. **Runtime context** — host info, sandbox config, execution routing hints
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-19-7. **Skills listing** — available skills as XML block
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:20:8. **Workspace files** — `AGENTS.md` and `TOOLS.md` from the data directory
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:21:9. **Long-term memory hint** — added when memory tools are registered
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:22:10. **Tool schemas** — compact list (native) or full JSON (fallback)
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:23:11. **Tool-calling format** — JSON block instructions (fallback providers only)
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:24:12. **Guidelines** — tool usage guidance, silent reply protocol
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-25-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-26-## Components in Detail
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-30-A single sentence that sets the assistant role:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-31-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:32:- With tools: *"You are a helpful assistant. You can use tools when needed."*
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:33:- Without tools: *"You are a helpful assistant. Answer questions clearly and
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-34-  concisely."*
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-35-
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-64->
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-65-> **Have opinions.** You're allowed to disagree, prefer things, find stuff
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:66:> amusing or boring. An assistant with no personality is just a search engine
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-67-> with extra steps.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-68->
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-69-> **Be resourceful before asking.** Try to figure it out. Read the file. Check
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:70:> the context. Search for it. _Then_ ask if you're stuck. The goal is to come
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-71-> back with answers, not questions.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-72->
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-87-> Just... good.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-88->
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:89:> **Continuity** — Each session, you wake up fresh. These files _are_ your
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md:90:> memory. Read them. Update them. They're how you persist. If you change this
runtime/cde-20260926/external/moltis-docs/docs/src/system-prompt.md-91-> file, tell the user — it's your soul, and they should know.
